question: The mission on Nano Science and Technology (Nano Mission) was launched in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2007.**__

 [IMAGE: ht
tps://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The mission on Nano Science and Technology (Nano Mission) was launched in 2007.
 
• The Nano Mission was an initiative by the Government of India.
 
• It was aimed at fostering the growth of research and development in the field of nanotechnology.
 
• The mission provided funding for research, infrastructure development, and human resource development in nanotechnology.
 
• It was launched by the Department of Science and Technology (DST).
